An elderly '''spacer''' of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Species/Legends|species]] lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and the spacer aided an explorer in tracking down the lost mines of [[Bos-Una Three]].<ref name="Myth Metal" />
